findings.title: GitGuardian SMTP Credentials Alert on commit c1a9ceb
findings.description: GitGuardian alerted on mock SMTP variables (smtp.mail.ovh.net, contact@vision-balling.fr, mock-secret-pw). Exhaustive git history audit (73 commits, 1,321 objects) proved 0 real secrets were ever committed. Unit tests used unittest.mock.patch to intercept smtplib.SMTP, preventing real network calls.
findings.remediation: Sanitized mock fixtures using RFC 2606 reserved domains (mail.test.example, ssl.test.example), invalid emails (test-sender@example.invalid), and explicit dummy markers (DUMMY-MOCK-TEST-AUTH-PASS). Added repository-level .gitguardian.yaml to prevent scanner noise on test suites.

findings.title: ReportLab XML Injection leading to Local File Inclusion (LFI) / SSRF in PDF Generation
findings.description: User-supplied title, coach, block title, and exercise content were directly formatted into ReportLab Paragraph objects. Because ReportLab parses an XML-like grammar for styling, unescaped input permitted tag injection ( or SSRF against cloud metadata 169.254.169.254).
findings.remediation:
Escaped all user-controlled text fields (title, coach, date, block title, block content) with html.escape(..., quote=True) prior to ReportLab Paragraph instantiation. Replaced newlines with
strictly after escaping.
findings.verification: Unit test test_pdf_generator_xml_escaping verifying payload with ,

findings.title: Multi-Tenant Job Token Overwrite / Hijacking on Content-Addressed Video Reuse
findings.description: When a video with an existing analysis key was re-uploaded, completed.access_token_hash was reassigned to the new uploader's token hash. This completely locked out the original owner from accessing their completed analysis.
findings.remediation: Introduced access_token_hashes list in AnalysisJob schema. In service.py, new tokens are appended to access_token_hashes without replacing the original token. In api/video_analysis.py, authorization verifies the candidate against all valid hashes via constant-time hmac.compare_digest.

findings.title: Unvalidated/Failed Video Upload Disk Space Exhaustion (Disk DoS)
findings.description: When video validation failed (VideoValidationError) or an unhandled processing exception occurred, the source video file on disk was not unlinked, leaving orphaned gigabyte-sized files indefinitely.
findings.remediation: Added source.unlink(missing_ok=True) in exception handlers for VideoValidationError and when VIDEO_RETAIN_SOURCE is false.
findings.verification: All video processing unit tests pass; failed jobs clean up disk space.

findings.title: Unhandled ZeroDivisionError & Missing FPS Bounds in Video Validation
findings.description: Malformed videos with avg_frame_rate='0/0' raised ZeroDivisionError which was not caught in _probe because ArithmeticError does not inherit from ValueError. Additionally, unconstrained FPS values (<= 0 or > 120) led to downstream division by zero in frame timing calculations.
findings.remediation: Added ArithmeticError to the exception tuple in _probe. Enforced strict bounds check (0 < fps <= 120) and positive duration/dimension validation in _probe_ffmpeg.

findings.title: Worker Thread Deadlock via Unbounded FFmpeg Normalization Subprocess
findings.description: FFmpeg and ffprobe subprocess commands ran without timeout in real_pipeline.py. Corrupted video/audio streams could cause FFmpeg to hang indefinitely, consuming worker threads.
findings.remediation: Added explicit dynamic timeout=max(30, int(metadata.duration_seconds * 4)) and -shortest flag to FFmpeg command, with 30s timeout on ffprobe validation.
findings.verification: Validated with corrupted stream error handling in pipeline execution.

findings.title: CUDA VRAM Accumulation via Missing empty_cache and Autograd Context
findings.description: Repeated video inferences caused intermediate activation memory to accumulate in PyTorch CUDA cache, risking CUDA Out-of-Memory (OOM) crashes across sequential jobs.
findings.remediation: Added torch.cuda.empty_cache() in the finally block of VideoAnalysisService._process_internal and wrapped RF-DETR model predictions in torch.inference_mode().
findings.verification: Full backend test suite passing with clean memory release.

findings.title: Global MatchEvidenceRegistry Concurrency Wipe During Pipeline Execution
findings.description: MatchEvidenceRegistry.clear() was invoked globally whenever an analysis finished, wiping all loaded match evidence sessions for concurrent users.
findings.remediation: Removed MatchEvidenceRegistry.clear() from the pipeline execution path, relying on per-analysis_id lazy loading in MatchEvidenceRegistry.get_or_load().

findings.title: CRLF Injection / SMTP Header Injection in Beta Request Single-Line Fields
findings.description:
The sanitize_text validator preserved  and 
 characters in single-line text fields (such as club, name, role). If injected with \r\n, text placed in email subject lines (f'[VISION-BALLING] Nouvelle demande BETA — {request.club}') could inject arbitrary SMTP headers.
findings.remediation: Implemented sanitize_single_line validator replacing \r, \n, and \t with single spaces and stripping control characters for all single-line fields.

findings.title: Trivial Rate Limiter Bypass via Spoofed X-Forwarded-For Header
findings.description: get_client_ip blindly trusted the first entry of the client-supplied X-Forwarded-For header, allowing an attacker to bypass the 5-request rate limiter by cycling arbitrary IP strings.
findings.remediation: Hardened get_client_ip to prioritize Cloudflare CF-Connecting-IP and trusted reverse-proxy X-Real-IP headers, falling back to the rightmost proxy hop.
findings.verification: Verified rate limiting test suite passes with hardened IP resolution.

findings.title: CI Frontend Build Failure Due to Missing VITE_API_URL Production Guard
findings.description: vite.config.js enforces that VITE_API_URL is mandatory for production builds to prevent silent localhost fallback. In CI, npm run build failed because no dummy URL was supplied.
findings.remediation: Injected env: VITE_API_URL: 'https://mock-api.vision-balling.com' into the frontend CI build step.
findings.verification: Local production build verification: npm run build successfully builds bundle.

findings.title: Missing Cloudflare Pages Security Headers (_headers)
findings.description: Cloudflare Pages deployment lacked an explicit _headers file, omitting X-Frame-Options, Content-Security-Policy, HSTS, and nosniff protection on the public frontend.
findings.remediation: Created frontend/public/_headers defining strict X-Frame-Options: DENY, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, Referrer-Policy, HSTS preload, and a tailored CSP allowing Google Fonts and Railway backend API.
findings.verification: Verified that _headers is copied into frontend/dist/ during vite build.

findings.title: Missing Sensitive Environment Pattern Exclusions in .dockerignore
findings.description: .dockerignore did not exclude .env*, *.env, credentials*, or secrets*, risking inadvertent inclusion of local configuration in built Docker images.
findings.remediation: Added explicit wildcard ignore rules for .env*, *.env, credentials*, and secrets*.

findings.title: Container Execution as Root User in Dockerfile
findings.description: Production Dockerfile ran backend uvicorn processes as root, violating principle of least privilege.
findings.remediation: Created non-privileged appuser/group and enforced USER appuser in the final image layer.
findings.verification: Dockerfile syntax and user definition validated.

findings.title: Permissive Wildcard ALLOWED_ORIGINS in render.yaml
findings.description: render.yaml had ALLOWED_ORIGINS: '*' as default value.
findings.remediation: Updated ALLOWED_ORIGINS to strict domain whitelist: https://vision-balling.fr,https://vision-balling.pages.dev.

findings.title: Internal Exception Leakage in /api/export-pdf Endpoint
findings.description: The endpoint returned raw str(e) on failure, potentially exposing file paths or internal library errors.
findings.remediation: Replaced raw exception detail with generic error message in production mode, logging full details server-side.

findings.title: Naïve Linear Image-to-Pitch Coordinate Mapping in RealVideoAnalysisPipeline
findings.description: RealVideoAnalysisPipeline uses an affine linear scaling (x/w)*105-52.5 rather than homography calibration. In broadcast camera angles, perspective distortions mean physical metric calculations (speeds, convex hull, compactness) are approximate.
findings.remediation: Documented in architectural limitations backlog. Full homography model from pitch_calibration.py to be integrated in post-RC2 release.

findings.title: Partition Overlap in EXP-22 Supervised Possession Training
findings.description: Supervised training in EXP-22 used SNMOT-061 and 062 in CONTROL_TRAIN, which were formally categorized as DEV in DATASET_POLICY.md.
findings.remediation: Documented in scientific integrity findings. Golden set remains completely unpolluted.

findings.title: Deterministic Template Fallback in EXP-26 Benchmark
findings.description: The EXP-26 benchmark was executed with force_offline_fallback=True, meaning the 100% claim support metric was achieved using deterministic template formatting rather than generative LLM inference.
findings.remediation: Documented in audit report for clear distinction between template evaluation and generative robustness.
